en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Al Awsa, from Abu Ja’far Al Musliy, from Suleyman Bin Sa’ad, from Mani’a who said,
‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Wearing the socks is a security from the tuberculosis’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from al-‘Awsiy from abu Ja’far, al-Musliy from Sulayman ibn Sa‘d from Muni’ who has said the following: “
Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Wearing al-Khuff (half-boot) provides immunity from tuberculoses.’”
